children: GOOG launched Gemini 4 Argon as its top Gemini 4 model, claims higher performance versus Pro and parity with frontier models; phased rollout underway to select partners, no public release date.
GOOG saw heavy options flow: calls >2x puts, over $260M in premium by midday, total options volume 50%+ above 30‑day average. Stock climbed ~2.7% amid tech rally.
GOOG rolled out Argon across engineering teams, including memory and quantum groups, and set a developer API intro price of $2 per million input tokens.
Alphabet Inc. Class C (GOOG): Google announced it will not release Gemini 3.5 Pro as previously planned, reversing an earlier statement/expectation that the model would be launched in June.
GOOG up ~2% at $344.03 after signing a voluntary AI safety pact requiring internal controls, independent audits and safeguards to limit AI access to tech infrastructure.
GOOG held about 29% of a combined cloud backlog near $1.688T in Q2 2026; traders watch how much of GOOG’s backlog converts to revenue toward a $1T target.
GOOG: CEO Sundar Pichai has shifted messaging—emphasizing Gemini’s cost advantages over rivals rather than just performance, signaling a focus on price competitiveness for the Gemini product line.
Lawmakers, led by Rep. Jamie Raskin, asked Alphabet (GOOG) for details on NDAs with government officials tied to data-center buildouts, and for disclosure of its data-center portfolio and NDA use.
GOOG: Google banned fixed-quota betting promos in Brazil effective immediately, blocking advertisers from running that specific betting-promotion creative under Brazil ad rules.
GOOG: Google will revoke current Brazil lottery and horse-racing certificates and require holders to reapply to continue related operations in Brazil.
